enrichment.core_claim: Near-death and out-of-body experiences arise from disinhibited microtubule consciousness after EEG stops, driven by photons, not from survival after death.
enrichment.ask_question: What measurement in dying patients could test whether microtubule photon activity continues after EEG flatlines?
enrichment.challenge_question: Is the claim that consciousness must dissipate heat via information erasure established, or an assumption doing most of the work?
